articles.title: Apple is holding its iPhone launch event on September 9
articles.summary: The event is expected to be a notable one, as Apple is rumored to unveil its long-awaited foldable iPhone. It'll also be the first Apple event with John Ternus as CEO, who is scheduled to take the reins of the tech giant from Tim Cook on September 1.

articles.title: Meta agrees to sweeping changes to restrict kids’ access to its apps as part of settlement with states
articles.summary: One of the most notable changes is that Meta plans to implement a daily two-hour time limit for teens that can only be disabled with parental permission.

articles.title: What’s driving Sweden’s startup boom, from Lovable to Legora
articles.summary: Vibe-coding darling Lovable just raised $400 million at a $13.3 billion valuation, roughly doubling its worth in eight months. articles.title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
articles.summary: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.

articles.title: Ex-Meta scientists want to bring visual AI to the factory floor
articles.summary: Perceptron offers an AI model that it says can help machines navigate the world while also providing in-depth visual intelligence.

articles.title: Ring introduces a new encryption standard, makes it the default for cloud features
articles.summary: Ring says  users can still opt for end-to-end encryption.

articles.title: Bill Gates wants to see a robot tax and ‘Human Reserved’ jobs to mitigate harms from AI
articles.summary: Gates is mostly in the Responsible AI camp, but there are a few ideas in here we hadn't heard before.

articles.title: CISA confirms hackers targeted over 100 US water systems during July
articles.summary: The federal cyber agency's warning comes amid a wave of suspected Iran-backed cyberattacks targeting critical water systems across the United States.

articles.title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model
articles.summary: Z.ai confirms it is behind Ox Alpha, the mysterious open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards, and its weights are set to be released soon.

articles.title: Meta settles for $18 billion in lawsuit brought by 29 states over social media harms to children
articles.summary: The lawsuit alleged that Meta knowingly designed platforms like Instagram and Facebook to addict children, despite knowing about the harms the platforms could pose to young users.

articles.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
articles.summary: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.

articles.title: Bluesky now lets you upload 10-minute long videos
articles.summary: Bluesky's new 10-minute video support includes faster upload speeds, too.

articles.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
articles.summary: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.

articles.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
articles.summary: Arga has raised $10 million in a seed funding round that was led by General Catalyst, with participation from Box Group, Emergence, Gradient and SV Angel.

articles.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
articles.summary: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.

articles.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
articles.summary: Runable says 60% to 70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.

articles.title: Ventures Platform goes bigger — and broader — with its second Africa fund
articles.summary: The Pan-African venture firm has raised $84 million and plans to invest in startups beyond its home market of Nigeria.

articles.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
articles.summary: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.

articles.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
articles.summary: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

articles.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
articles.summary: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."
